verdict.rationale: Claude exposes a comprehensive, extensively documented public Messages API with SDKs, CLI, streaming, batch processing, tool use, MCP connector, admin/usage APIs, and model discovery endpoints, all fully documented at platform.claude.com. Independent probes confirm the docs are live (llms.txt 200) though a public OpenAPI spec wasn't found and one probe path 404'd. Missing for 10: publicly discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec and independent third-party corroboration beyond Anthropic's own docs.
